config.basis: tensor Bernstein polynomial, bounded coefficients; NOT the previous neural SBC
config.environment: weather/color fixed throughout an episode; separate B(x,e), gamma(e), c(e)
config.conditional_process_model: zero residual of current analytic capture backend; conditional expectation degenerates to one outcome
config.image_errors_in_training: actual frozen image-path actions at exact image distances, not global residual boxes
config.target: finite-horizon safety against unsafe/domain exit, NOT task completion or infinite-horizon SPVC equivalence
config.bound_if_all_dynamics_proved: failure <= gamma(e)+H*c(e); appearance-uniform mixture uses average of these budgets
config.global_region_conditions: nonnegative bounded polynomial, optionally capped at1; unsafe/domain-exit B=1 and safe-terminal B=0 by construction; initial upper via Bernstein restriction convex hull
config.unresolved: dynamics constrained at finite exact-image states; no continuous action-map or new-policy trajectory coverage proof
